title: Hearty British Almond Flour Fritters
description: Nutty, silky and energizing fritters made with almond flour and blanched almonds, perfect for a Buddhist‑temple friendly breakfast or lunch, served in a classic bubble‑and‑squeak style.
instructions: Rinse blanched almonds and pat dry before chopping finely.
Whisk eggs with oat milk, honey, and salt until smooth.
Combine almond flour, baking powder, and chopped almonds into a bowl.
Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients, stirring until a thick batter forms.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a non‑stick pan over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the pan, flattening slightly to create fritters.
Fry each side for 3 to 4 minutes until golden brown and crisp.
Sprinkle fresh thyme, chives, and grated ginger over the hot fritters.
Serve immediately with a side of mixed greens or a simple parsley sauce.
